description: News headlines for the new core's stories, by the kind of record they report. News sources give patterns only; every part here is a headline from U.S. federal agencies' own news releases (public domain), with record words as slots.

slots.subject: The business or office, from the event record.
slots.law: The law, as its record names it.
slots.wage: An hourly wage, from the law record.
slots.place: A place, from the place records.
slots.money: A dollar amount, from the record.
slots.purpose: What the money is for, from the record.
slots.name: A person, by name, from the records.
slots.office: An office, from the office records.
slots.age: An age, computed from the birth record.
slots.employer: An employer, from the job record.
slots.term: A prison term, from the sentence record.
slots.crime: An offense, from the charge record.
slots.opponent: The other candidate, from the contest record.
slots.measure: The measure, as its record names it.
slots.body: The governing body, from its record.
slots.action: What the body voted to do, from the measure record.
slots.matter: What the case was about, from the enforcement record.
slots.occasion: What is being marked, from the event record.
slots.value: A law amount in words, from the law record ("$15 an hour", "6 percent").
slots.percent: A rate in percent, from the record ("5.3").

mining.rule: A shape is kept when at least 2 documents say it as a whole sentence and one of them is a public-domain record from 2015 or later, which is its source.

secondRun.note: Parts the rebuilt corpus attests that the first run's corpus did not, merged into the first run's parts.
